description: The advanced version of the Truffle runtime for Graal Languages, providing additional features such as sandboxing or auxiliary engine caching. It is not recommended to depend on this artifact directly. Instead, use a POM dependency of one or more Graal Languages (for example `org.graalvm.polyglot:js`) to ensure all dependencies are pulled in correctly.
